MethodArgument: awk -F: '($1!~/(halt|sync|shutdown|nfsnobody)/ && $7!~/^(\/usr)?\/sbin\/nologin(\/)?$/ && $7!~/(\/usr)?\/bin\/false(\/)?$/) { print $1 " " $6 }' /etc/passwd | while read -r user dir; do [ -d "$dir" ] || echo "$user"; done | wc -l

Name: Ensure users' home directories permissions are 750 or more restrictive
MethodArgument: awk -F: '($1!~/(halt|sync|shutdown|nfsnobody)/ && $7!~/^(\/usr)?\/sbin\/nologin(\/)?$/ && $7!~/(\/usr)?\/bin\/false(\/)?$/) { print $6 }' /etc/passwd | while read -r dir; do [ -d "$dir" ] && [ "$(stat -L -c "%a" "$dir")" -gt 750 ] && echo "$dir"; done | wc -l

Name: Ensure users own their home directories
MethodArgument: awk -F: '($1!~/(halt|sync|shutdown|nfsnobody)/ && $7!~/^(\/usr)?\/sbin\/nologin(\/)?$/ && $7!~/(\/usr)?\/bin\/false(\/)?$/) { print $1 " " $6 }' /etc/passwd | while read -r user dir; do [ -d "$dir" ] && owner=$(stat -L -c "%U" "$dir"); [ "$owner" != "$user" ] && echo "$user $dir $owner"; done | wc -l

Name: Ensure users' dot files are not group or world writable
MethodArgument: awk -F: '($1!~/(halt|sync|shutdown|nfsnobody)/ && $7!~/^(\/usr)?\/sbin\/nologin(\/)?$/ && $7!~/(\/usr)?\/bin\/false(\/)?$/) { print $6 }' /etc/passwd | while read -r dir; do [ -d "$dir" ] && find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -name ".*" -type f -perm /go+w 2>/dev/null; done | wc -l
